page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8y.small is an ARM64-based virtual machine instance powered by a dedicated 2.75 GHz Alibaba Yitian710 processor. It features 1 physical core with 1 thread, providing a single dedicated vCPU. The instance is configured with 8.0 GB of RAM, establishing a 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio. It operates on the KVM hypervisor, lacks local storage, and includes a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps. The Yitian710 processor includes 64 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 64 MB of L3 cache, with hardware support for AES cryptography, though it lacks x86-specific vector extensions like AVX or AMX.

Benchmark data highlights the performance characteristics and inherent tradeoffs of this single-core ARM configuration. In single-core processing, the instance achieves average performance in stress-ng and single-threaded gzip compression. However, because the instance is limited to a single vCPU, its multi-core performance is identical to its single-core output, resulting in poor multi-core benchmark ratings. Memory bandwidth is also limited, with uncached large-block read speeds of 18.26 GB/sec and write speeds of 7.15 GB/sec. Database operations, Redis SET performance, and static web serving throughput also fall into the lower tier of benchmarked instances.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.r8y.small offers a low-cost entry point for ARM64 architecture testing and development, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio without the premium associated with larger multi-core instances. It is best suited for lightweight, memory-leaning workloads that do not require parallel processing, such as basic single-threaded applications, lightweight caching, development environments, and simple web serving.

The instance relies on network-attached storage, has a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps, and runs on the KVM hypervisor.
